content.short: Tonation lets streamers receive instant cryptocurrency donations with wallet payouts and viewer messages.
content.description: Tonation is a crypto donation platform for streamers. Its site describes instant viewer support, direct wallet payouts, a fixed commission model, customizable animations and sounds, and message voicing for donations. The product is social because it connects creators and audiences around live support rather than acting as a general wallet. A platform for streamers to accept instant cryptocurrency donations. The product is social first, with Web3 rails used for ownership, payments, reputation, or participation.
